3.speaker: Player_Romus
3.text:
"I think we've started on the wrong foot here. Before we talk further, I want to raise a glass to all of you."
[Give the signal]

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "A wise man once said, 'Resistance to change is futile when the wheels of time turn unceasingly.'"

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "I've called you in here as a courtesy to let you know that there's going to be some changes around here."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "Thank you everyone for coming here this evening. I have something important to tell you."

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Once inside, I closed the door, leaving the celebrations behind us.
7.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"]) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"]) == false)

8.speaker: Hugo Toras
8.text: "Well, I think the curtain in this room looks just fine, Your Majesty."

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: There was a ripple of light laughter among the group.

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "For centuries, the monarchy has been the stabilizing force of Rizia..."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "You people have taken Rizia for granted."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "Rizia deserves more than the weight of its history -- she deserves a future unshackled from the past."

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: There was a tense silence followed by uneasy glances.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: It was subtle, but it was enough.

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "To my mother, Queen Estela, and to the future of Rizia!"

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: As we lifted our glasses, the doors clicked shut.

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "Now. I want everybody to listen to me very carefully."

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: The nobles exchanged confused looks, their unease growing.

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "We can no longer ignore the growing reform movement nor their legitimate request to be granted their political rights."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "This is the time to heed the calls of the people. They have been loud and clear."

32.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
32.text: Gesture to the servers to bring the constitutional draft.

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: I gestured at the servers to bring forth the paperwork they were holding.

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: They approached the table and laid the constitutional draft, "The Rizian Fundamental Law," upon it.

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "So... I've gathered you here on this meaningful day to reform our great kingdom and finally give the people of Rizia the right to rule themselves."

36.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
36.text: "Give me a break. This is a direct attack against the Rizian monarchy."

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: He grasped the wheels of his chair and turned toward the door.

41.speaker: Lucita Azaro
41.text: "Your Majesty, you must admit that this is incredibly ill timing. Our focus should be on the war, not reform."

42.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
42.text: "I did not leave the frontlines just to listen to this populist drivel."

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "While the Crown has borne the weight of your greed and apathy, you grew fat on the very people you were meant to serve."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "But I see no heirs to this legacy, only scavengers circling a dying institution."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "But clinging too tightly to tradition risks dragging us into ruin."

64.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
64.text: "Yes, Your Majesty... What exactly is it you're implying?"

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "I will be transferring the Crown's lawmaking powers to the House of Delegates entirely."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Alright. I'll be clear. We are reforming the Kingdom with a new constitution, and you are not going to stand in its way."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "What I'm implying is that there will be changes. Changes that prioritizes the people of Rizia over the nobility."

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: The chamber seemed to freeze, their eyes reflecting shock and muted outrage.

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "I need you to sign these documents to show your support for the outlined changes."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: Manus gave me a troubled glance.

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "That really doesn't matter. You will have to accept the changes either way."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "Feel free to read the proposal in detail. When you've finished, add your signature, if you please."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "I know all of you have your own personal opinions and concerns about this. That’s why I’ve brought you here -- to ensure we embrace this change together on the best possible terms."

80.speaker: Narrator
80.text: The chamber seemed to freeze, their eyes reflecting shock and muted outrage.

81.speaker: Narrator
81.text: After a long silence, Hugo was the first to act. He leaned on the table and took a look at the proposal.

82.speaker: Hugo Toras
82.text: "Really? You brought Sazon's proposal to us?"

86.speaker: Hugo Toras
86.text: "Really? You brought the RPP's proposal to us?"

87.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
87.text: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, you cannot simply make that decision on your own."

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: General Taddeus was the first to break the silence.

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "As a matter of fact, I can."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "Please, General. You must understand this is a necessity."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "If you don't want any trouble, you'd better just play along and sign the documents."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: Everyone was seated around a long table, the taxidermied animal heads looming above them.

96.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
96.text: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from communist thugs?"

98.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
98.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SecurityThreat"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false)

112.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
112.text: "The boy who wants to dismantle the Rizian Crown?"
112.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SecurityThreat"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false)

113.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
113.text: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from enemies of the state?"

114.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
114.text: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses bow to populism?"

125.speaker: Manus Sazon
125.text: "With all due respect, General, Mr. Sotelato is the leader of the RPP. He represents a greater part of the Rizian population than House Azaro does."

129.speaker: Manus Sazon
129.text: "With all due respect, General, Mr. Sotelato is the Speaker of the House of Delegates. He represents a greater part of the Rizian population than House Azaro does."

134.speaker: Manus Sazon
134.text: "And with all due respect, as the leader of the RPP, I represent a greater part of the Rizian population than House Azaro does."

138.speaker: Manus Sazon
138.text: "Nobody wants to dismantle the monarchy. The RPP only wants reforms. A true constitutional monarchy."

140.speaker: Angelica Sazon
140.text: "House Sazon has nothing to do with this, General. Please be more respectful when speaking about my son."

141.speaker: Leona Sazon
141.text: "House Sazon has nothing to do with this, General. I advise you to be more respectful to my cousin."

146.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
146.text: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from anti-monarchists?"

151.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro

158.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
158.text: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses bow to populism?"

162.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
162.text: "The traitor's son who wants to dismantle the Rizian Crown?"
162.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SecurityThreat"] == true) == false)

163.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
163.text: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from enemies of the state?"

165.speaker: Lucita Azaro
165.text: "Should have known he was part of this."

172.speaker: Hugo Toras
172.text: "So it is true. You were collaborating behind the scenes then? Without consulting the Royal Houses?"

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: All eyes snapped to Manus, their gazes filled with alarm.

174.speaker: Rico Toras
174.text: "Should have known he was part of this."

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: Hugo stood up and looked at me.

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "If our monarchy is to survive this century, we must adapt. Fully empowering the House of Delegates and entrusting governance to the people is the only path forward."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "The Rizian People's Party has already drafted the constitution together with the reform movement. It is more than evident that this is what the people want."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "I wholeheartedly support the calls for reform. I ask you to do the same."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "Feel free to read the proposal in detail. When you've finished, add your signature, if you please."

181.speaker: Narrator
181.text: Hugo leaned on the table and took a look at the proposal.

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: The others nodded in approval. Hugo stood up and looked at me.

183.speaker: Hugo Toras
183.text: "Is is true, Romus? You were collaborating with this man behind the scenes? Against the wishes of the Royal Houses?"

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "None of that matters now, Hugo. What *does* matter is that these reforms will be enacted."

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "I had to hide it. You gave me no other choice."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "It is true. I won't become a monarch who desperately clings to power in this day and age. The reformists are right about Rizia's future."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "It is true. When acceded the throne, I told everybody that I intended to reform the country, didn't I?"

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "I'm not here to have a debate. Please cooperate so we can move on."

194.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
194.text: "Nobody will be signing anything. What you're asking is unacceptable. You'll have no support from us, Your Majesty."

195.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
195.text: "Forcing our hand in this underhanded way is not just unconventional -- it's a blatant insult to the Royal Houses of Rizia."

196.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
196.text: "With all due respect, House Azaro will take its leave."

200.speaker: Rico Toras
200.text: "I will say right from the start that His Majesty's opinion does not reflect that of the rest of House Toras."

204.speaker: Hubertus Toras
204.text: "The need for such a radical action is by no means evident, Your Majesty."

205.speaker: Angelica Sazon
205.text: "The need for such a radical action is by no means evident, Your Majesty."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "You are mistaken. I am not *asking* for your support."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "Regardless of what happens today, I truly appreciate everyone who has supported me over the past few years."

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: There was a tense silence followed by uneasy glances.

233.speaker: Hubertus Toras
233.text: "Should have known he was part of this."
